scope: Proposition 4.3 (Pathwise interior restart) of the manuscript “An exact Hausdorff gauge for SLE” (preprints/An-exact-Hausdorff-gauge-for-SLE-September-25-2026/An-exact-Hausdorff-gauge-for-SLE-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 230 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 513ca9aedce0f342), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a stopping time S. On {S < ∞} put JS = (gS − BS)−1 : H → HS, and let ˜︁ µ be the canonical mass functional of the fresh Brownian motion BS+t − BS. Almost surely, as measures on HS, simultaneously for all 0 ≤ t ≤ ∞, (µS+t − µS)|HS = (JS)∗ (︁ |J′ S|d ˜︁ µt )︁ . (4.10) The same assertion holds when the initial domain is a fixed conformal image of H. Once this equality of measures has been obtained, one may integrate any random nonnegative Borel weight on the restart domain and evaluate at any later random time.
